assessments.reasoning: Section 4, printed and physical page 3, describes the minus mark on variables and record fields as read-only in the importing module and gives the IdentDef production. Section 8.1, printed and physical page 7, explicitly carries read-only status from a read-only array or record designator to its element or field designator.

challenge.method: Challenge importer versus declaring-module access, asterisk versus minus marking, array/record subdesignators, and a claim of recursive immutability through dereference.
challenge.results: The source confines the export restriction to importing modules, and the expressly described propagation covers array elements and record fields. The candidate gives the direct selector cases and leaves pointer reachability and deep immutability outside its scope.

limitations: The read-only finding is restricted to the quoted language construct and the stated designators in the report edition.
